chung.Syllabus Name: Professional Public Relations Writing_Viết bài PR chuyên nghiệp
chung.Time Allocation: Study hour (150h) = 45h contact hours + 1h final exam + 104h self-study
chung.Description: This advanced-level course offers students a comprehensive examination of PR writing in both Vietnamese and English. Participants will acquire skills in goal identification, information curation, and the strategic creation and publication of content. The course also explores the symbiotic relationship between PR writing and the dynamics of transmedia storytelling in attracting and influencing audiences. Through practical exercises, students will engage in designing, sharing, and participating in cohesive storytelling experiences across a range of traditional and digital platforms, including entertainment, advertising, marketing, and social change. The curriculum further encompasses the effective application of AI tools to enhance storytelling and transmedia production processes.

- Students must attend at least 80% of contact slots in order to be eligible to the final examination.

- Laptops may be used in class solely for learning purposes.

- Students must promptly access the FLM at https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/ for up-to-date course information

taiLieu: Strategic Public Relations Writing: Proven Tactics and Techniques
Public Relations Writing: Essential Tools for Effective Storytelling
Becoming a Public Relations Writer: Strategic Writing for Emerging and Established Media
Natalie T. J. Tindall, Amber L. Hutchins, Ronald D. Smith
clo: Analyze organizational and audience contexts to identify strategic communication goals and environmental factors that shape effective PR writing decisions.
Evaluate and justify appropriate PR writing approaches tailored to specific project objectives and stakeholder expectations.

Produce and adapt professional PR content that demonstrates advanced proficiency across various purposes, formats, and media platforms, addressing diverse PR scenarios and demonstrating practical application and effective collaboration.
Critically utilize AI-assisted tools and digital analytics to enhance creativity, accuracy, and strategic effectiveness in PR content development and campaign evaluation.

Demonstrate professional, ethical, and culturally responsive communication practices that uphold transparency, accountability, and social responsibility in both individual and team-based PR writing contexts.
danhGia: Participation is assessed on a 0–10 scale, rounded to one decimal place, and is awarded based on attendance, preparedness, professional learning attitude, and the quality of contributions to class discussions throughout the semester.

Opt.1: Suggest Group Project Requirements
Working in groups, students will select a real-world public relations case involving a communication challenge faced by a real organization in Vietnam. The case must have occurred within the past 12–24 months and be supported by credible, publicly available sources (e.g., news media, official statements, corporate platforms).
Students will analyze the case, justify an appropriate PR writing strategy, and produce a professional Public Writing (Media) Kit tailored to multiple audiences and platforms.
1. Context & Strategic Analysis
Briefly introduce the selected case and critically analyze:
• Organizational background and communication challenge
• Key stakeholders and target audiences
• Social, cultural, political, or digital environmental factors influencing PR writing decisions
2. PR Writing Strategy & Justification
Evaluate and justify the most appropriate PR writing approach for this case by addressing:
• Communication objectives
• Message framing and key narratives
• Tone, voice, and style
• Platform and channel selection
Justifications should be grounded in stakeholder expectations, professional PR standards, and strategic intent.
3. Public Writing (Media) Kit
Develop a Public Writing Kit that demonstrates advanced professional PR writing skills and audience adaptation.
The kit should include at least three (3) of the following (minimum requirement) in both Vietnamese and English:
• Press release / media announcement
• Media pitch or briefing note
• Public-facing statement or Q&A
• Internal communication (e.g., staff memo, internal update)
• Social media post set (with platform rationale)
All materials must: (a) Be written in a professional PR style; (b) Clearly indicate target audience and purpose; (c) Be coherent, ethical, and culturally responsive
In this section, also discuss ethical and cultural considerations, including: (a) Transparency and accountability; (b) Risk of misrepresentation or bias; (c) Social responsibility and inclusivity
4. AI & Digital Tools Reflection
Reflect critically on the role of AI-assisted tools and digital analytics in this project. It’s important to note that AI use is optional and must not replace the student’s own analysis. :
• How AI tools could or were used to support PR writing or evaluation
• BenefIt’s (e.g., efficiency, creativity, insight generation)
• Limitations and ethical risks (e.g., accuracy, bias, over-reliance)
Include a clear AI Use Declaration stating: (a) Whether AI tools were used; (b) Which tools were used (if any); (c) For what purposes (e.g., ideation, editing, analytics support)
5. Recommended Deliverables
A. Group Written Report
• Length: 2000–2500 words (excluding appendices)
• Contents: (a) Case overview & strategic analysis; (b) PR writing strategy & justification; (c) Ethical and cultural considerations; (d) AI & digital tools reflection
• Format: All assignments should be typed and double-spaced with 12-point font, and must be submitted in soft copy
B. Public Writing (Media) Kit
• Minimum 3 professionally written PR materials
• Clearly labelled by audience and platform
• Assessed primarily on writing quality and strategic fit
C. Presentation (pptx file)

Opt.1: Suggested Individual Assignment
Scenario
The Organization - Mat Trang Theater: Founded 20 years ago, Mat Trang is a centerpiece of the city’s cultural heritage. It is known for "bridging cultures", serving a diverse population of traditional families, young professionals, and a large ethnic minority community. Historically, the theater has been supported by both government grants and private donors who value social harmony.
The Production- The Happiness: This is the theater’s most ambitious project to date and is scheduled to premiere on the final day of this month in Ho Chi Minh City. The play follows two families from different racial backgrounds as they navigate a modern romantic relationship, and it features a prominent LGBTQ+ protagonist.
In other cities where the play has previously been staged, it has generated strong public reaction. While some conservative groups have criticised the production for It’s mature themes, civil rights organisations have praised it as “one of the most important plays of the decade.”
The Crisis - The "Divisive" Narrative: The City Gazette (the local newspaper) recently published an editorial titled "Art or Activism?" It argues that Mat Trang Theater is abandoning It’s "unifying" roots to push a political agenda. The editorial claims that local parents feel the themes are "unsuitable for a family-oriented city" and calls for a boycott.
Your Role: As the PR Manager, you must defend the theater's artistic integrity while reassuring the community that the theater remains a welcoming place for everyone, not just activists.
Assignment Instructions
Your task is to demonstrate your ability to write clear, strategic, and audience-appropriate public relations materials in response to the situation described above.
You are required to complete both writing tasks below. Your writing should reflect professional PR standards and show awareness of tone, audience, and context.
Task 1: Write a professional news release (300-400 words) announcing the theater’s new season and the featured play The Happiness. The news release is intended for local news editors and cultural journalists.
Your news release must:
• Clearly communicate the key news (the launch of the new season and the featured play)
• Position the theater as a responsible and culturally engaged organization
• Highlight the theater’s commitment to artistic expression, inclusion, and community dialogue
• Address the relevance and importance of the play’s themes (racial justice and LGBTQ+ inclusion) in contemporary society
• Use inclusive, positive, and strategically appropriate language suitable for a broad public audience
Task 2: Compose a short social media post (200-250 words) for the theater’s official Facebook page to promote the opening night and encourage community participation.
Your post must:
• Be clear, engaging, and appropriate for a public social media platform
• Encourage attendance and respectful dialogue around the play’s themes
• Reflect the theater’s values of inclusion, openness, and community engagement
• Include a clear Call to Action (CTA) (e.g., “Tickets available at…”, “Join our post-show Q&A”)
• Use a “community-first” tone
Visual Direction
•Include one sentence describing the image or video you would pair with the post (e.g., “A photo of the cast and director speaking with audience members after rehearsal”)
Note: All information in this assignment is fictional and has been created solely for examination purposes
